A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
life change events are related to disorders but not to the degree that would make them useful as predictors of disorders.
the number of life change events experienced in the past 12 mo. correlated significantly with the number of psychological and physical disorders experienced in that same period.

the more life changes a person experiences, the more physical and psychological disorders he is likely to have, but only if the life change events are weighted by the means of all subjects or by the means of the subjects who have had the experience.
The main takeaway from our work is that
life change events can be measured in several different ways.
the life events questionnaire is a useful tool for assessing stress and its effects on mental and physical health.
life change and disorders have a small, but significant relationship with each other.
